description: This file contains utility functions for determining related charts based on filters and chart customization within a dashboard, specifically for the Superset project.

methods.name: isGlobalScope
methods.description: Checks if the scope includes all slices.

methods.name: getRelatedChartsForSelectFilter
methods.description: Determines related charts for select filters based on scope.

methods.name: getRelatedChartsForCrossFilter
methods.description: Determines related charts for cross filters based on scope and filter key.

methods.name: getRelatedCharts
methods.description: Main function to get related charts based on filter type and scope.

methods.name: getRelatedChartsForChartCustomization
methods.description: Finds related charts based on chart customization settings.
